expression_parent_rule: parent_expression_inherited names the expression parent. That may be the family parent or a prior room in the same family.
plate_rule: A distinct product job does not require a new plate. NEW_PLATE_WITHIN_FAMILY only when the job, emotional role, or spatial metaphor materially changes.

notes: The welcome still life is owned by entry. Do not repeat it as the hero of a later family.
Historical entry screens each have a plate file. New work reuses or modulates. Do not add another entry plate because it is easy.

family_expression.spatial_metaphor: The threshold of a coastal house.
family_expression.architectural_character: Welcome is the atrium. Later screens are quieter rooms of the same house.
family_expression.lighting_character: High side light on the welcome wall. Child moments stay softer.
family_expression.material_emphasis: Plaster, stone, bone, a little burgundy cloth.
family_expression.panel_language: Few surfaces. Forms sit on the plaster.
